name: Boneshatter Juggernaut
summary: League-start melee build. Boneshatter trades a little life for stacks, so the gear is armour and resistances, the axe is a rare with attack speed, and the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable. Herald of Purity and Vulnerability turn the axe into damage, and no unique is required, which is what a strength build needs on day one of a solo league.

sub.watch: Ground Slam with Ruthless and Added Fire Damage carries acts 1-2. Take Ground Slam as the Marauder reward, buy Ruthless after Mercy Mission, and add Added Fire at 8. Keep a mana flask, because slam attacks are mana-hungry before leech, and do not spend currency on a rare axe yet.

sub.watch: Sunder clears packs and hits single targets harder than Ground Slam, so it carries you from 12. Boneshatter unlocks at 28 but keeps the same four links and asks you to stand still and stack trauma, so it is not a damage jump until Brutality is in the link. Herald of Ash unlocks at 16; keep it off until the 28 step, because it reserves a quarter of the bar and Sunder is mana-hungry before leech. The mana flask is only for this stretch: Mana Leech unlocks at 31 and takes over in the 28-38 step. Stay on Sunder and do not fix the stretch with currency.

sub.watch: Stay on Sunder through 38: this step is the Sunder measurement, not a Boneshatter step. Brutality is already usable at 38, but the guide swaps at 39 when the next step opens. The four links and the missing rare axe are what make this stretch feel bad, so spend nothing to fix it and save for the axe. Cast when Damage Taken carries Immortal Call only: at 38 the unreserved pool is 67 mana, and Immortal Call plus Vulnerability would cost 109, so self-cast the curse. Herald of Ash and Determination are the auras here. Mana Leech replaces Faster Attacks and pays for the attacks, so this step does not need a mana flask; swap Ash for Herald of Purity at 39 when Brutality replaces Added Fire and the Karui Chopper supplies the leech.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.
The two-handed gear profile no longer inherits a shield; armour rolls and a chaos belt raise life, EHP and max hit at every map checkpoint.
Weapon-scoped tree targets stop points going to one-hand and mace-crit notables under Resolute Technique.
Herald of Purity, Vulnerability, Added Fire Damage and a Silver Flask raise measured DPS; re-rated S+.
The Karui Chopper carries mana leech, and the 28-38 step uses Mana Leech Support instead of a mana flask.
The leveling filter and step plans were corrected for Resolute Technique and the 5-link/6-link wording.
The 28-38 step now has its own 41-point tree and stays on Sunder; Boneshatter starts at 39 with Brutality and its own gate report.
The 39-68 step uses the Karui Chopper's mana leech; no mana flask is needed.
Ascendancy labs are named correctly: Unflinching, Unbreakable, Undeniable and Unrelenting.
Ground Slam and Ruthless open the leveling; Sunder takes over at 12 and Boneshatter at 39.
Herald of Ash covers the pre-Brutality Sunder stretch; Herald of Purity returns when Brutality replaces Added Fire.
Cast when Damage Taken carries Immortal Call only; Vulnerability is self-cast because the 38 mana pool cannot pay both.
The early and 68 checkpoints use level-legal gear, and the axe carries a Dexterity roll it can equip.
The 28-38 step runs Mana Leech instead of Faster Attacks and drops the mana flask; the Karui Chopper's leech covers the 39-68 step.

summary.text: Boneshatter Juggernaut is a two-handed melee build that measures 434.0k at red maps and 620.8k at pinnacle. The rare axe, armour rolls and Herald of Purity carry the damage, the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Ground Slam and Ruthless until Sunder unlocks, then stay on Sunder for the measured stretch. Take Ground Slam as the Marauder reward, buy Ruthless after Mercy Mission, and add Added Fire when it unlocks. Brutality is already usable before the swap; the guide moves to Boneshatter at the next step, because the Sunder checkpoint is what the gate measures. A better two-handed axe is an upgrade, not a gate. The first checkpoint measures 425 life and 35 damage; the second measures 1.3k with a self-cast Vulnerability. The mana flask covers the early stretch; Mana Leech takes over in the next leveling step, and the Karui Chopper adds weapon leech when the build swaps to Boneshatter.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 434.0k damage, 30206 effective life and 12237 physical max hit. Herald of Purity is the damage aura; Vulnerability is self-cast and Cast when Damage Taken carries Immortal Call only, because the mana pool cannot pay both. The axe's mana leech keeps the quarter-full mana bar up. Cap the elemental resistances, keep the axe current, and swap Close Combat for Melee Splash when you want faster packs.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 620.8k damage with 39287 effective life and 15201 physical max hit. Use Enduring Cry before the burst, keep Vulnerability up, and keep the trauma stacks running while you move out of the biggest slams.
